flows.objective: Navigate to the page and click the primary call-to-action button labelled 'View portfolio'. PASS requires ALL of the following: (1) the click causes a visible change on the page, (2) a visible portfolio section or panel is present, and (3) that panel contains at least one company name. Report PASS if all three conditions hold. Otherwise report FAIL and state which condition was not met.

Read the whole page. PASS requires ALL of the following: no visible text reads 'undefined', 'null', 'NaN', 'Lorem ipsum', 'TODO' or 'coming soon', every table cell contains a real value, and there are no broken image placeholders. Report PASS if all conditions hold. Otherwise report FAIL and quote the exact offending text.

View the page at a narrow mobile viewport of 375px wide. PASS requires ALL of the following: the page does not scroll sideways, and the headline and the primary call-to-action are fully visible, not overlapping and not cut off. Report PASS if both conditions hold. Otherwise report FAIL and state which condition was not met.
